Medicare and Medicaid’s 60th anniversary isn’t just a celebration—it’s a wake-up call. While politicians posture, Medicaid hemorrhages $55B annually in improper payments, fueled by bureaucratic bloat and systemic abuse. The real crisis? Hospitals drowning in waste while ERs overflow with non-citizens exploiting loopholes.

Vicente Gonzalez’s party expanded eligibility to millions of illegal immigrants, accelerating collapse. Republicans aren’t “attacking services”; they’re enforcing accountability. Prioritize Americans who paid in, audit every dollar, and end the fraud.

No more taxpayer-funded care for those who broke the law to get here. Secure the system for citizens first—that’s real compassion.

Since 1965, Medicare and Medicaid have provided high-quality affordable healthcare for millions of Americans, including hundreds of thousands of South Texans. However, the Trump Administration and Republicans have passed the One Big, Ugly Bill to strip 17 million Americans of their healthcare coverage, including 1.6 million Texans just to satisfy the desires of the ultra-rich.
